question: What is the meaning of guidelines for handling and disposal in relation to hazardous substances?
description:
Guidelines for handling and disposal of hazardous substances ensure safe and environmentally responsible management of these materials. They provide specific instructions on how to handle, transport, and dispose of hazardous substances to minimize their impact on the environment and human health. These guidelines are crucial for maintaining compliance with local and global recycling regulations and optimizing recycling rates. They also help in preserving the reliability and recyclability of materials during disassembly and end-of-life handling. <|ENDINPUT>
